colossus_rhodes.event: A harbor swell moves from left to right and breaks across the breakwaters, with rain and beacon reflections.
colossus_rhodes.shared_prompt: Preserve the original stage artwork and fighting deck beneath a transparent overlay. Animate only the listed ambient event. Eight deterministic phases form a seamless loop; keep particles behind fighters and away from the floor.
phases: particles enter along the upper-left edge: rain streaks fall over the harbor water.
the breeze carries particles across the left background: rain streaks fall over the harbor water.
particles drift through the center background: rain streaks fall over the harbor water.
particles pass behind the landmark: rain streaks fall over the harbor water.
particles move into the right background: rain streaks fall over the harbor water.
the breeze carries particles toward the right edge: rain streaks fall over the harbor water.
the trail thins as particles leave the frame: rain streaks fall over the harbor water.
the first particles reappear at the upper-left edge: rain streaks fall over the harbor water.
colossus_rhodes.frame_strategy: The eight full-scene frames are the original Colossus of Rhodes harbor-wave sequence from PR #555; no transparent sprite overlays.
